name: Marcus Aelswith the Third
source:
Ringo aka Marcus Aelswith the Third. Born with every possible advantage and privilege, but sometimes everything just isn't enough. Ringo decided that life was just too dull in the mansion and a life of crime would be much more satisfying. He became part of a small criminal organization lead by [url=/c176875]Anthony "The Harmmer" Tomasi[/url]. Ringo is one of the main suspects in the theft of the pearl necklace, and an all together despicable individual… or maybe just misguided? Ringo is aggressive, lacks a sense of humor, and self-centered.

[Edited from in-game description]
